name: Liga Stavok
note: Russian bookmaker; premium partner of HC Shanghai Dragons for the 2026-27 season, with its logo reported already on the team's kit (Stavki.ru and Vedomosti, both 2026-09-02); RBC Sport (2026-09-08) also reports the company became the team's exclusive bookmaker. Club president Ilya Kovalchuk and bookmaker president Yuri Krasovsky signed the agreement (Stavki.ru, Vedomosti). Ownership of the betting company not traced from a primary document.
